description: Count hosts matching <query> with facet breakdown (free — this endpoint does not consume query credits). Returns the total match count plus optional facet aggregations (e.g. top countries, orgs, ports). Example: shodan_host_count({ query: "apache", facets: "country:10", _apiKey: "your-key" })

_apiKey.description: Shodan API key (account.shodan.io; paid membership required)

facets.description: Comma-separated facets for aggregation, e.g. "country:10" or "org:5,port:5" (optional)

query.description: Shodan search query, e.g. "apache" or "port:443 country:DE"

name: shodan_host_count
title: Shodan Host Count
